content:
maya: heads up — release cutoff in ~4h. can folks do a quick pass on their changelog entries? focus on: component tag, concise bullet, and linking PRs.
ajay: noted. do we still want the `impact` short tag (low/med/high) or drop it for this cycle?
maya: keep it. we need something to triage release notes for customers.
olivia: quick q — what's the canonical entry shape? pasting example:
```\n- component: runtime\n- description: tightened default batching interval to reduce latency spikes\n- pr: #4821\n- impact: low\n```
olivia: s/`- component`/`component:`/ above — small style nit
ryan: will audit my PRs now. ping me if I miss any formatting.
release-bot: :robot_face: automated check: found 2 entries missing `component` tag in `release-candidate` branch. Run `/changelog-lint` to see details.
ajay: thanks bot. running lint now — got one that's more than a line. can we keep descriptions <=2 sentences?
maya: yes, prefer 1 line summary + optional 1 sentence detail. Marketing will trim, but we want a clean source.
olivia: fixed my entries and added PR links. pushed quick follow-up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4890
ryan: any guidance on version bumps? I bumped my microservice to `v0.9.7` but not sure if we should bundle a minor bump.
maya: if it's backward-compatible opt-in, keep micro bump. we'll coordinate the release tag script later.
ajay: obv don't forget to add the CHANGELOG label to PRs so release bot can pick them up.
maya: if anyone can't make the cutoff, leave a comment with `release: next` and a short reason.
ryan: ack — will do if needed.
maya: final ask: if you touched infra/runtime, add `component: runtime` explicitly. thanks :pray:
release-bot: :white_check_mark: reminder scheduled for 2h before cutoff.
